description: Aljal Public Data (알잘 공공데이터): Public places: museums and art museums (국공립 · 대학 박물관 · 미술관, admission fee and closing days), public libraries (loan limits, opening hours, closing days), and public indoor playgrounds including Seoul kids cafes (서울형 키즈카페). With no inputs: the kinds in this group, what each answers, and the conditions it can be narrowed by. With a kind: a nationwide summary of that kind. With a region, conditions or words: matching places (default 10), each with an id for get_place, a one-line summary and the page URL. Results are in Korean.

filters.description: Optional condition keys, all must hold. Valid keys per kind are listed in the result `next.filters` (e.g. free, walkin, indoor, pets, monday). 조건.

from.description: Optional offset to continue a list (`nextFrom` from the previous result).

limit.description: Optional number of places to return, default 10, max 30.

query.description: Optional words to match against place names and addresses, in Korean, e.g. "장충", "글로벌도서관". 이름 · 주소 낱말.

region.description: Optional Korean region name: 시도 (서울, 경기, 부산) or 시군구 (강남구, 수원시, 분당). 지역.

name: explore_civic_places
title: 공공 시설 찾기
